database.name: VIEW ETGO_SUPPORT_CLIENT_V
database.view: SELECT c.ad_client_id AS etgo_support_client_v_id, '0' AS ad_client_id, '0' AS ad_org_id, c.isactive, c.created, c.createdby, c.updated, c.updatedby, c.ad_client_id AS target_client_id, c.name AS client_name, ow.ad_user_id AS owner_user_id, ow.name AS owner_name, ow.email AS owner_email, COALESCE(cl.claimed_at, c.created) AS registered_at, (SELECT max(s.created) AS max FROM etgo_go_session s WHERE s.ctx_client_id = c.ad_client_id AND s.etgo_support_access_id IS NULL) AS last_login, (SELECT p.value FROM ad_preference p WHERE p.ad_client_id = c.ad_client_id AND p.attribute = 'ETGO_EnvironmentType' AND p.isactive = 'Y' ORDER BY p.updated DESC LIMIT 1) AS environment_type, (SELECT p.value FROM ad_preference p WHERE p.ad_client_id = c.ad_client_id AND p.attribute = 'ETGO_DemoTrialStartedAt' AND p.isactive = 'Y' ORDER BY p.updated DESC LIMIT 1) AS trial_started_at, (SELECT p.value FROM ad_preference p WHERE p.ad_client_id = c.ad_client_id AND p.attribute = 'ETGO_SubscriptionStatus' AND p.isactive = 'Y' ORDER BY p.updated DESC LIMIT 1) AS subscription_status, sa.etgo_support_access_id, sa.operator_user_id, sa.support_expires_at, 'N' AS access_as_support, 'N' AS close_support_session FROM ad_client c LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT u.ad_user_id, u.name, u.email FROM ad_user u WHERE u.ad_client_id = c.ad_client_id AND u.em_etgo_is_owner = 'Y' ORDER BY u.isactive DESC, u.created LIMIT 1) ow ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT max(tp.claimed_at) AS claimed_at FROM etgo_tenant_pool tp WHERE tp.pool_client_id = c.ad_client_id AND tp.status = 'CLAIMED') cl ON true LEFT JOIN LATERAL (SELECT a.etgo_support_access_id, a.operator_user_id, CASE WHEN a.ticket_used_at IS NULL THEN a.ticket_expires_at ELSE (SELECT max(s.absolute_expires_at) AS max FROM etgo_go_session s WHERE s.etgo_support_access_id = a.etgo_support_access_id AND s.is_revoked = 'N') END AS support_expires_at FROM etgo_support_access a WHERE a.target_client_id = c.ad_client_id AND a.ended_at IS NULL AND (a.ticket_used_at IS NULL AND a.ticket_expires_at > now() OR (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM etgo_go_session s WHERE s.etgo_support_access_id = a.etgo_support_access_id AND s.is_revoked = 'N' AND s.expires_at > now() AND s.absolute_expires_at > now()))) ORDER BY a.created DESC LIMIT 1) sa ON true WHERE c.ad_client_id <> '0' AND c.ad_client_id <> '802509E12436405C86BA1FD5B1DF508C' AND NOT (EXISTS (SELECT 1 FROM etgo_tenant_pool tp WHERE tp.pool_client_id = c.ad_client_id AND tp.status <> 'CLAIMED'))
